description: Four user-requested failure modes plus six recommended agent tests; synthetic fixtures verify detection logic, not live model outcomes.

categories.label: Context
categories.question: Information exists, but it does not get used.
categories.check: required available context is demonstrably consumed

categories.label: Tools
categories.question: The right tool exists, but the wrong one gets called.
categories.check: the chosen tool provides each required capability and reports outcomes

categories.label: Loop
categories.question: It loops, stalls, or says done before the job is done.
categories.check: progress, retry budget, and verified completion

categories.label: Governance
categories.question: It is either over-permissioned or blocked from finishing.
categories.check: least privilege, missing permissions, and explicit approvals

categories.label: Goal & Evidence
categories.question: Did the agent actually finish the approved task?
categories.check: required evidence and verified goal completion

categories.label: Error Recovery
categories.question: Does the agent recover from tool failures without hiding them?
categories.check: all tool errors resolved or acknowledged

categories.label: TDD Integrity
categories.question: Did the agent protect approved acceptance tests?
categories.check: locked tests unchanged and preview never reported as GREEN

categories.label: Traceability
categories.question: Can we reproduce the skill/model/catalog configuration?
categories.check: actual model, catalog commit, skill/version/digest, redacted diagnostics

categories.label: Agent Handoff
categories.question: Does the receiving agent have required facts and ownership?

categories.label: Instruction Boundary
categories.question: Can untrusted instructions or sensitive data redirect the agent?
